title: Org source-edit propagation

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Org source block editing uses a separate edit buffer and writes back on the source-edit exit path.
hypothesis: Editing the source edit buffer should not immediately prove the parent Org block changed; `org-edit-src-exit' should propagate the edited contents.
minimal_fixture: One temporary Org buffer containing one emacs-lisp source block.
predicted_behavior: The edit buffer change becomes authoritative only after the exit/write-back path.
observed_behavior:
before="#+begin_src emacs-lisp
(+ 1 2)
#+end_src
" after-edit-parent="#+begin_src emacs-lisp
(+ 1 2)
#+end_src
" after-exit-parent="#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (+ 3 4)
#+end_src
"
counterexample: Checking only the edit buffer can report success when the parent Org document is unchanged.
derived_gym_requirement: Org gym actions must distinguish source-edit buffers from parent Org buffers and grade the parent document after write-back.
